name: OMNI-DOCK — Steam Hardware Convergence Station
concept: ONE physical station where ALL Steam hardware + sporeGate converge. northGate (RTX 5090) is the sun. Everything else orbits and absorbs.

steam_deck_v1.battery: DEAD — permanent USB-C passthrough = ALWAYS ON when powered
steam_deck_v1.role: PRIMARY DISPLAY — mounted, Gaia HUD kiosk, touch input
steam_deck_v1.dock_position: CENTER — the main screen Kevin sees

steam_frame.soc: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (ARM64!) — first ARM SteamOS node
steam_frame.role: GAIA'S FACE — shows what the brain thinks, Remote Play receiver

connections.usb_tether: USB to sporeGate for wired connection

steam_frame.dock_position: RIGHT — secondary display, Gaia's face to Kevin

steam_link.role: RELAY — plug into ANY HDMI display = instant Gaia viewport
steam_link.dock_position: OUTPUT — connects to big screen / TV / any HDMI
steam_link.streaming_from: northGate Steam (RTX 5090) via Steam Remote Play

steam_controller_v1.features: TMR trackpads, gyro, accelerometer, HD haptics
steam_controller_v1.role: GAIA'S HANDS — physical input for games + HUD navigation

bindings.gyro: Camera look / tilt / VR head tracking proxy

steam_controller_v1.controller_1: Paired to Steam Deck (BT) — primary input
steam_controller_v1.controller_2: Paired to Steam Link (dongle) — secondary / TV input

sporeGate.role: LOCAL COMPUTE DOCK — DNS, DHCP, heart-pull, game data cache

connections.usb: Can USB-tether to Steam Frame for wired bridge

sporeGate.dock_position: UNDERNEATH — the compute engine the dock sits on top of

omni_dock_topology.sun: northGate RTX 5090 — the GPU that powers everything

orbit_1_display.steam_deck: Mounted center — Gaia HUD (touch), powered USB-C
orbit_1_display.stream_source: northGate Steam Remote Play OR local SteamOS gaming

orbit_2_face.steam_frame: Right side — Gaia's face, ARM SteamOS

orbit_3_relay.steam_link: HDMI out to TV/monitor — big screen mode

foundation.sporeGate: Under the dock — DNS, cache, 20% game data mirror, local AI

step_1_power: sporeGate: plug in power (laptop, always-on lid-closed)
Steam Deck: USB-C power (dead battery = permanent dock)
Steam Frame: USB-C power (can tether to sporeGate)
step_2_network: Steam Deck: WiFi to Black Mesa (5GHz) — IP .176
Steam Frame: WiFi to Gaia (or USB tether to sporeGate)
Steam Link: ethernet to switch OR WiFi
step_3_display: Steam Deck: 7" built-in LCD (no HDMI needed)
step_4_input: Controller #1: pair to Steam Deck via BT (hold Steam+X)
Controller #2: 2.4GHz dongle into Steam Link USB port
Nunchucks: I2C to sporeGate for gesture control
step_5_streaming: northGate Steam: enable Remote Play in Settings → Remote Play
Steam Link: pair to northGate (same Steam account)
Steam Frame: pair to northGate (Steam Remote Play)
Steam Deck: can play local OR stream from northGate

kiosk_mode.link: Stream Gaia HUD from northGate browser → HDMI → TV
kiosk_mode.use: Ambient organism display — Gaia shows her state 24/7

gaming_mode.what: northGate RTX 5090 streams game to ALL displays
gaming_mode.link: Steam Remote Play from northGate → TV
gaming_mode.use: Kevin plays on big screen, Deck shows stats, Frame shows Gaia's face

coliseum_mode.what: Multiple games running, each display shows different game
coliseum_mode.sporeGate: sourDough monitors all + inner_eye GPU telemetry
coliseum_mode.use: Gaia plays 3 games simultaneously, Kevin watches the coliseum

mirror_mode.what: Kenshi Mirror — Gaia plays, all screens show reflections
mirror_mode.link: GPU telemetry + AI reflections on TV
mirror_mode.sporeGate: Caches game data, runs local analysis
mirror_mode.use: The organism watches itself play through multiple eyes

vr_prep_mode.what: Half-Life: Alyx prep — lighthouse tracking + VR stream
vr_prep_mode.frame: Shadow Cast → VR frame delivery to headset
vr_prep_mode.controllers: VR hand input proxy via gyro + trackpad
vr_prep_mode.lighthouses: Vive base stations for room-scale tracking
vr_prep_mode.use: Full VR pipeline: northGate renders → Frame displays → controllers track

sporeGate_dock_services.dns_cache: Local DNS resolution for all dock devices
sporeGate_dock_services.game_cache: 20% of each played game cached locally (BitTorrent for self)
sporeGate_dock_services.heart_pull: Pulls Gaia state every 2 min from eastGate
sporeGate_dock_services.telemetry_relay: Receives sourDough data, relays to eastGate gut
sporeGate_dock_services.usb_bridge: USB-tether to Steam Frame for wired connection
